critical_code_review_comments: ServicesPage.js is ~895 lines — approaching the >700 line threshold. Consider splitting the 14 section blocks into smaller sub-components (e.g., ServicesHero, WhoHelpsGrid, ReadinessPathTable, PricingReferenceBlock) for maintainability. Not blocking.

Minor (pre-existing, not from this change): console warning 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' on /vince-inspecting.webp on HomePage. React expects camelCase fetchPriority. Cosmetic only — no functional impact.

analytics.js trackEvent auto-appends first/last-touch attribution params alongside the explicit cta_text/cta_destination/page_path — verified does not interfere with acceptance criteria (extra keys allowed).
